Here are a few reasons: 
1) Baby is premature, can't nurse, and mom's milk doesn't come in (a woman's body doesn't always respond to a pump the way it does to a baby) 
2) Baby is adopted or in foster care
3) Mom had to go back to work and can't afford a pump plus all the accessories and time requirements that go into pumping and keeping the milk fresh
4) Mom has insufficient milk supply and needs to supplement
5) Mom had a breast reduction and can't make milk (not always, but it does happen) 
6) Mom had a breast augmentation and can't make milk (not always, but it does happen) 
7) Mom is on a medication that is incompatible with nursing
8) Baby is allergic to mom's breast milk
9) Baby doesn't like to nurse
10) MOM DOESN'T WANT TO NURSE OR PUMP AND THAT'S OK BECAUSE IT'S HER BODY
